entities.name: Ilona Štěpánová-Kurzová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ilona Štěpánová-Kurzová was a Czech concert pianist and piano teacher. She worked as a professor at the Academy of Arts, Architecture and Design in Prague. Her students included Ivan Moravec. Ilona Štěpánová-Kurzová was the mother of pianist Pavel Štěpán.

entities.summary: Ilona Štěpánová-Kurzová was a Czech concert pianist and piano teacher. She worked as a professor at the Academy of Arts, Architecture and Design in Prague. Her students included Ivan Moravec. Ilona Štěpánová-Kurzová was the mother of pianist Pavel Štěpán.
